text:
maria_cs: Heads up — we've got an incident affecting onboarding flows for several customers. Tokenization errors intermittently returning 502s during model init. Created INC-4321. Affected: BrightLeaf (trial onboarding), NimbleAI (pilot), and two enterprise proofs-of-concept. Need comms plan + owner for outreach. @kevin_eng @sam_ce?

incident-bot: Incident INC-4321 created by maria_cs — severity: P2 — detected 2025-04-27T14:45Z.

kevin_eng: I'm looking into model-serving logs now. Root cause looks like an edge-case in tokenizer fallback after rolling quantized model. Immediate mitigation: rolling back the last kernel change from this morning. ETA for rollback: 20m. Will follow with patch.

devon_escalations: Customer list and risk notes:
- BrightLeaf (trial) — onboarding stuck, low revenue but high expansion potential; onboarding scheduled call tomorrow, risk: moderate
- NimbleAI (pilot) — demo failure, trial converting to paid next month, risk: high
- OrionHealth PoC — enterprise, legal in loop, risk: high (renewal conversation in 6 weeks)
- Polaris Analytics PoC — low usage, risk: low

sam_ce: I can own the customer comms for BrightLeaf + NimbleAI. I'll draft email and schedule urgent calls. Suggest short templated status + ETA + mitigation + offer of one-on-one. Draft below:

```
Subject: Update on onboarding issue — immediate mitigations in progress
Hi <Name>,
Wanted to let you know we detected an issue affecting onboarding that may have impacted your recent requests. Our engineers are rolling back a model kernel change now and expect recovery in ~30 minutes. We will follow up with a full RCA and next steps. If you'd like a call, I'm available today 16:00-17:00 PT.
Thanks for your patience — Sam (Customer Engineering)
```

anna_success_mgr: Please include explicit SLA/credits language only after legal signoff. Tagging @lee_legal. Also flag NimbleAI for possible renewal impact; recommend a proactive outreach with executive sponsor if they request credits.

lee_legal: Confirmed — we can offer a goodwill credit and a formal SLA credit calculation post-RCA. Sam, keep language soft: "we are investigating and will follow up with next steps and any applicable credits."

kevin_eng: Rollback complete at 2025-04-27T15:03Z. Error rate for tokenizer calls dropped from 18% to 0.5% in the last 5 minutes. Deploying hotfix to prevent regression.

maria_cs: Thanks team. Sam — can you send initial status emails to BrightLeaf and NimbleAI and offer calls? Include CC to me and anna_success_mgr. Devon — please create a short timeline doc for each account (impact start, mitigation, current state, recommended owner).

sam_ce: Sent initial messages to BrightLeaf and NimbleAI at 15:12Z. Both acknowledged; BrightLeaf accepted a call at 16:30 PT. NimbleAI requested an exec intro if credit discussion needed. I added the soft credit wording per legal.

kevin_eng: Hotfix rolled at 15:18Z. Monitoring dashboards look stable. I'll keep the patch in canary for 2h then promote. Preparing short RCA notes that I'll drop here after initial postmortem with infra.

devon_escalations: Timeline doc created and shared in drive: https://drive.internal/redwood/INC-4321-timeline (private link). Contains per-account impact, recommended remediation owners, and renewal risk flags.

maria_cs: Good. Next steps: 1) Sam — follow-up calls completed and transcript/notes saved to the account threads. 2) Kevin — finalize RCA draft by EOD. 3) Anna/Lee — prepare credit guidance if customers request. 4) I'll coordinate exec outreach for NimbleAI if needed.

maria_cs: Marking this thread for customer-communications tracking. We'll convert to final post-incident thread after RCA. Thanks everyone — nice rapid response.

kevin_eng: RCA draft posted 18:40Z. Summary: regression introduced by kernel selection logic for quantized tokenizer edge-case; fix: guard clause + extended unit tests. Full RCA scheduled for 2025-04-28 11:00 PT (invite sent).

sam_ce: Post-call notes uploaded to CRM. BrightLeaf onboarding resumed this morning. NimbleAI asked for an exec touchpoint; arranging now.

maria_cs: Final: initial customer outreach completed, mitigations applied, RCA meeting scheduled. I'll publish customer-facing RCA after legal review. Closing internal comms thread — follow-ups tracked in respective account threads.
